profile_text.body:
Coursera is a public company, incorporated in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, that operates an online learning platform at coursera.org. It trades under the ticker COUR and is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001651562. On its own site, the company describes its offerings as online courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees, with content from organizations it names including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford. It also offers Coursera Plus, described as an annual subscription giving unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates.

The site presents the platform as focused on job-ready skills and verifiable credentials, and points to programs such as the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, the AI Essentials Specialization, the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, the Machine Learning Specialization, the Python Specialization, the Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate, the Data Analysis with Python Specialization, and the UI/UX Design Specialization. It says learners commonly move into roles in project management, UX design, and data science, and that others start with beginner-friendly Python or generative AI courses. The company describes its certificates and Specializations as designed in collaboration with employers and universities.

The record also shows a law exposure count of 281 in California. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for the company.
